lines.t: We hear it, we feel it
Breath unsteady in our chests
You say you're coming down
The earth shakes beneath our steps
The nations quake at prophecy
Trembling starts within
Burn what clings to darkness, Lord
Make all straight when you descend, you say
Cry out for mercy, mercy, Lord, is my cry
Saying lift your voice, grace, grace
May grace become our light
Grace, grace, let it pour on us like rain
Mercy, mercy, etch it on our heart again
Holy one of Israel
Prepare us for your flame
Grace, grace
We call upon your name
You warn the world of judgment
Even weak ears heard your call
Melt what stands in pride
Lord, on feet of clay we stood tall
The lofty crash down before you
So bring our heights to low
Let reverence be our trembling
And holy fear be all we know
You say the Lord shall roar
So let that roar awaken us
You said you'd search the hearts of men
Finding us the fire you see
Grace, grace, let it pour on us like rain
Mercy, mercy, pull me from my former ways
Holy one of Israel
Prepare us for your flame
Grace, grace
We call upon your name
And as we cry we hear the others' voices rising
Where we stand our trembling gathers into one
Our hearts move by your hand
You say peoples of the earth cry out
So we lift the name you gave
Grace, grace, mercy for the nations you have saved
Grace, grace, we cry out as your own
Mercy, mercy, let your righteousness be made known
Holy one of Israel, your footsteps shake the ground
Grace, grace, your remnant gathers
Now we cry out
We call your name
Holy one of Israel
Come down, come down
Oh, come
Call me
